book.name: 2 Timoseo
book.title: Ɨnyarʉbha ya kabhɨrɨ ya Paaurʉ kwa Timoseo

content: Kʉbha nu ubhwigumirirya momeremo ja Mungu
Nangʉ mwana waanɨ, ʉbhɨ na amanaga kʉnzɨra yɨ ɨbhɨgʉngi bhɨnʉ tubhwɨnɨ ku kwisirirya Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ.
Wiigwirɨ amiija ganʉ nakwijiryɨ mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwa abhamɨnyɨɨkɨrɨri bhaaru. Nangʉ ʉbhahɨ amiija gayo abhaatʉ abharonge, bhanʉ bhakʉtʉra kwija abhandɨ.
Wiigumiriryɨ mʉnyaakʉ hamwɨmwɨ na niinyɨ, nchu umusirikarɨ ʉmʉzʉmu wa Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ.
Atareeho musirikarɨ wʉnʉ akutiga kokora emeremo ji ikisirikarɨ, asikɨrɨ momeremo gɨnʉ gɨtarɨ ji ikisirikarɨ. Atakwisikirya mugiyo, kʉ kʉbha areenda komozomerya ʉmʉkʉrʉ waazɨ.
Nʉʉrʉ wʉnʉ akuhiza mwibharaana, atakʉtʉra kʉhaabhwa ʉmʉbhanʉ arɨɨtamɨ kwangarɨra imigirʉ ja ribharaana.
Umurimi wʉnʉ akohocha kumucha, wuyo areenderwa kʉbha we embere kobhona amagesa.
Timoseo, wiseege bhʉkʉngʼu igʉrʉ wa amangʼana ganʉ nɨkʉkʉbhʉʉrɨra. Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Mungu arakoha ʉbhʉnaja bhwu ukwobhoora gʉʉsi.
Uhiitɨ Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ wi ikishoko chʉ ʉmʉtɨmi Daudi,
Mungu akamuryʉra kurwa mʉbhaku. Yiyo neyo Ɨngʼana Ɨnzʉmu yɨnʉ nikurwaza.
Kʉ kʉbha yɨ ɨngʼana yiyo, inyɨ nɨranyaaka na kobhohwa ne emenyororo nchʉ ʉmʉbhɨ. Nawe ɨngʼana ya Mungu ɨtakʉtʉra kobhohwa.

Igʉrʉ wa riyo, niriigumirirya gʉʉsi igʉrʉ wa abhaatʉ bhanʉ bharʉbhwɨrwɨ na Mungu kʉbha kwawe, korereke bhʉʉsi bhasʉngʼaanɨ ubhutuurya kʉhɨtɨra Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ, na kugwatana nʉ ʉbhʉgʉngʉ bhwa kemerano.
Ringʼana rɨnʉ ni‑rya amaheene:
Amaswaja komohocha ʉmʉzʉmu wa Mungu
Ʉbhahiityɨ abhiisirirya amangʼana gayo, na kʉbharecha mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwa Mungu, bhatigɨ kʉhakaana igʉrʉ wa amangʼana amasuuhusuuhu. Zɨhaka ziyo zɨtaana bhwera, na zɨrabhasarya bhanʉ bhakwigwa.
Ikongʼeererya kwija ringʼana rya amaheene, chɨmbu ikwenderwa kwa Mungu. Hayo ʉrabha omohocha wʉnʉ ataana sʉni igʉrʉ we emeremo jazɨ. Kokorabhu nekwe Mungu akwisirirya.
Utigɨ amangʼana ganʉ gataana bhwera bhwʉbhwʉsi, kʉ kʉbha gayo garatʉʉra abhaatʉ kore bhʉkʉngʼu na Mungu.
Amiija gaabhʉ gaangɨ rigaati rɨnʉ rɨkʉtamanyʉra ʉmʉbhɨrɨ. Gatɨ waabhʉ bharimu Himɨnayo na Fireto.
Bhayo bhabhurirɨ bhʉkʉngʼu, bhatigirɨ amaheene kʉ ʉkʉgamba kʉbha, ubhuryuku bhwa abhaku bhʉmarirɨ kʉhʉrʉka. Ku kwijabhu, bhararimirya ubhwisirirya bhwa abhaatʉ abhandɨ.
Nawe abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhiimiiriirɨ bhwɨma, bhaangɨ ʉbhʉrʉsa ʉbhʉnagu bhʉnʉ bhʉtɨɨrwɨ na Mungu. Ni igʉrʉ wʉ ʉbhʉrʉsa bhuyo gaandikirwɨ amangʼana ganʉ, “Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Mungu amɨnyirɨ abhaatʉ bhaazɨ,”
nʉ, “Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ akwibhɨrɨkɨra ewe nɨ‑wʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Mungu, atigɨ ʉbhʉbhɨ.”
Munyumba ɨkʉrʉ, bhirimu ebhegero bhyaru, bhirimu bhyɨ ɨzahaabhu na zimpirya, bhyo obhototo na bhyɨ ɨmɨtɨ. Ɨbhɨndɨ bhyu ubhwera, ɨbhɨndɨ bhɨtarɨ bhyu ubhwera.
Nangʉ, ʉmʉʉtʉ ariibhɨngukyɨ ku kutiga ʉbhʉbhɨ bhuyo bhwʉsi, arabha nche ekegero cha amahocha ga hagarɨ kɨnʉ kɨrʉbhwɨrwɨ, arabha isiririibhwɨ kʉMʉkʉrʉ waazɨ, arabha isiriiryɨ komeremo jʉsi ɨmɨzʉmu.
Utigɨ umwʉyʉ gu ubhumura, ʉbhɨ ne eheene, ubhwisirirya, ʉbhʉsɨɨgi no omorembe, hamwɨmwɨ na bhʉʉsi bhanʉ bhakʉsabha Ʉmʉkʉrʉ kumwʉyʉ umwɨrʉ.
Utigɨ kutuna zɨhaka ze ekegeege zɨnʉ zɨtaana bhwera, kʉ kʉbha ʉmɨnyirɨ ziyo zɨrareeta iryʉmana.
Naatu, ɨtakwenderwa omohocha wʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ kʉbha mwʉmani. Nawe abhɨ mwigumirirya, mʉnyʉʉhu kʉbhaatʉ bhʉʉsi, nʉ ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ akʉnaja kwija.
Areenderwa abhɨ arabhahama kwa bhʉnyʉʉhu abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhakʉhakaana nawe, korereke hamwɨ Mungu abhahɨ kutiga ʉbhʉbhɨ na komenya amaheene.
Neho, amangʼɨɨni gaabhʉ gabhagarʉkɨrɨ, bhasabhʉkɨ kurwa mwiheto rya Shɨtaani. Ewe abhagwatirɨ, korereke bhabhɨ bharakora ubhwɨndi bhwazɨ.

footnotes.text: Daudi. Kʉmaragɨrɨra bhʉkʉngʼu, rora Ikiniibhasa. Rora 2 Samwɨri 7:12‑13.
